label: chromium__assistant-slash-command-menu-open
description: Pre-existing violation outside the Assistant composer under test. The Basic Prompting starter's Language Model node renders the 'model is not available' badge as a <span> with aria-label, which IBM reports as aria_attribute_valid (aria-label on an implicit generic role). The badge only appears because the E2E backend has no provider configured. Fix it in the canvas model input component and delete this file; the slash-command menu itself scans clean.

results.message: The ARIA attributes "aria-label" are not valid for the element <span> with implicit ARIA role "generic"
